role: Retrospective wetting-screen prediction and observation comparison
source: Waszkiewicz et al. (2025), Zenodo 18046315, through authenticated EWP FORM_A source inputs; fixed D0 form-A tuples
rights: CC-BY-4.0 source data; original numerical redraw; raw source and native CFD traces remain external
scope: All 56 measured histories, eleven nominal conditions, and one common 23-pressure DESCRIPTIVE_ALL sweep per arm

encodings.onset_left: Signed held-out detector-median errors in seconds at each nominal pressure; upward arrows mark lower bounds when the full-cohort median is not identified
encodings.onset_right: Descriptive constant-pressure beverage-mass detector on the common 0.1-s observation grid; bounds remain marked
encodings.flow_left: Held-out endpoint condition means; black markers are scale-derived beverage-flow observations, colored markers are scored liquid rhoQ predictions
encodings.flow_right: Single-tuple descriptive 100-s endpoint sweep; W2T includes its observation lag
encodings.lines: Connections between sampled summaries, not added observations or a claim of a unique continuous detector minimum
encodings.intervals: No interval ribbon is plotted. Paired intervals are in PAIRED_COMPARISONS.csv, conditional on fitted wetting parameters and transferred tuples; bound differences are labeled separately
encodings.rows: 1–2 bar in the top row, 3.5–13 bar below, to keep the high-pressure detail visible while retaining every nominal condition; all 56 brews remain in scoring

ceiling: Comparison of frozen-law predictions using an engineering R0 chemistry model. No physical validation, causal mechanism identification, chemistry calibration, untouched-target claim, or inference beyond the declared grids and support. Geometric front timing remains a separate reported quantity.
